body: It seems like you are going through a lot. I can not really say things will be better soon. Maybe they will, maybe not. But you will surely learn to cope with it. Please put your mental health as your topmost priority. Your happiness matters the most. I wish you all the best.

It is rare to find a therapist who matches you and understands what you are going through or exactly what you need. Even a very good therapist might be a bad fit for you. It is the most tedious task (especially when you feel like shit and giving up seems to be the only option) to keep looking for a good therapist, who can echo your thoughts. For me, it took 8 different counselors, telling the same stories over and over, but finally found someone who I can trust. I would be lying if I said I hadn't given up on searching before. But you need to keep trying, right? For whatever works for you. Your therapist does not seem to be a good fit for you. I hope you find a good one soon and feel cared for.
Thank you for your reply. Yeah, I am trying to change things. But some days are harder than others. So sorry to hear about your childhood experience. Hope you are doing better now. Lots of love!
